question.text: Kaveri Macro Fund is launching a Large Value Fund (LVF) for Accredited Investors under Category III. What is the minimum investment amount per investor (other than Sponsor/Manager or their employees) in an LVF?

explanation.text: The Logic: A Large Value Fund for Accredited Investors is an AIF/scheme in which each investor (other than Manager/Sponsor and their employees/directors) is an Accredited Investor AND invests not less than INR 25 crore. The general AIF minimum is INR 1 crore; the employee/director minimum is INR 25 lakh; the LVF minimum is INR 25 crore. The Trap: Option A is the general AIF minimum. Options B and D are plausible-sounding but incorrect figures. Note: Workbook pages 396, 399, and 404 cover LVF status, which also supports concentration concessions, extension flexibility, and PPM filing/intimation relaxations described in the source. Keep the INR 25 crore minimum as the anchor.
